janus:skip: Recorded match:false doesn't follow from unanchored regex.is_match semantics (the actual pact_matching engine's own behaviour, and what shape-language spec section 4.2 documents v1-v4 as doing): 'alligator named .{4}' is found as a substring of 'alligator named brent' at 'alligator named bren'. Likely a historical artefact of a different regex library/implementation than the one pact_matching now ships. Every other regex case in this corpus passes under the same unanchored semantics, so this is flagged as a known, isolated disagreement rather than chased.
